title: 饣 food (食字旁)
intro: 饣 is the simplified left-side form of 食 (food), written in three strokes. At the bottom the full 食 returns (餐). Characters with 饣 are about meals, hunger, fullness, specific foods, and places that serve them.

ex.zh: 我饿死了，我们去吃饭吧。
ex.p: wǒ è sǐ le wǒ men qù chī fàn ba
ex.en: I'm starving, let's go eat.

ex.zh: 这家饭馆的菜又便宜又好吃。
ex.p: zhè jiā fàn guǎn de cài yòu pián yi yòu hǎo chī
ex.en: The food at this restaurant is cheap and tasty.

ex.zh: 你吃饭了吗？
ex.p: nǐ chī fàn le ma
ex.en: Have you eaten?

ex.zh: 我饿死了，我们去吃饭吧。
ex.p: wǒ è sǐ le wǒ men qù chī fàn ba
ex.en: I'm starving, let's go eat.

ex.zh: 我不饿。
ex.p: wǒ bù è
ex.en: I'm not hungry.

ex.zh: 孩子饿了，给他一块饼干吧。
ex.p: hái zi è le gěi tā yī kuài bǐng gān ba
ex.en: The child is hungry, give him a cookie.

ex.zh: 我吃饱了，谢谢。
ex.p: wǒ chī bǎo le xiè xie
ex.en: I'm full, thanks.

ex.zh: 你吃饱了吗？再吃一点儿吧。
ex.p: nǐ chī bǎo le ma zài chī yī diǎnr ba
ex.en: Are you full? Have a bit more.

ex.zh: 北方人过年喜欢包饺子。
ex.p: běi fāng rén guò nián xǐ huan bāo jiǎo zi
ex.en: Northerners like to make dumplings at New Year.

ex.zh: 你喜欢什么馅儿的饺子？
ex.p: nǐ xǐ huan shén me xiànr de jiǎo zi
ex.en: What filling do you like in your dumplings?

ex.zh: 我喜欢吃饺子。
ex.p: wǒ xǐ huan chī jiǎo zi
ex.en: I like eating dumplings.

ex.zh: 这家饭馆的菜又便宜又好吃。
ex.p: zhè jiā fàn guǎn de cài yòu pián yi yòu hǎo chī
ex.en: The food at this restaurant is cheap and tasty.

ex.zh: 图书馆几点开门？
ex.p: tú shū guǎn jī diǎn kāi mén
ex.en: What time does the library open?

ex.zh: 宾馆离这儿不远。
ex.p: bīn guǎn chī zhèr bù yuǎn
ex.en: The hotel isn't far from here.

ex.zh: 你想喝什么饮料？
ex.p: nǐ xiǎng hē shén me yǐn liào
ex.en: What would you like to drink?

ex.zh: 健康的饮食很重要。
ex.p: jiàn kāng de yǐn shí hěn zhòng yào
ex.en: A healthy diet is important.

ex.zh: 中秋节的时候大家都吃月饼。
ex.p: zhōng qiū jié de shí hou dà jiā dōu chī yuè bǐng
ex.en: Everyone eats mooncakes at Mid-Autumn Festival.

ex.zh: 孩子饿了，给他一块饼干吧。
ex.p: hái zi è le gěi tā yī kuài bǐng gān ba
ex.en: The child is hungry, give him a cookie.

ex.zh: 早上我吃了两个馒头。
ex.p: zǎo shang wǒ chī le liǎng gè mán tou
ex.en: I ate two steamed buns this morning.

ex.zh: 春节的时候，家里有很多装饰。
ex.p: chūn jié de shí hou jiā lǐ yǒu hěn duō zhuāng shì
ex.en: At Spring Festival, homes have lots of decorations.

ex.zh: 你喜欢什么馅儿的饺子？
ex.p: nǐ xǐ huan shén me xiànr de jiǎo zi
ex.en: What filling do you like in your dumplings?

ex.zh: 餐厅在哪儿？
ex.p: cān tīng zài nǎr
ex.en: Where is the dining hall?

ex.zh: 我们今天吃中餐还是西餐？
ex.p: wǒ men jīn tiān chī zhōng cān hái shi xī cān
ex.en: Are we eating Chinese or Western food today?

ex.zh: 我们在学校餐厅吃午饭。
ex.p: wǒ men zài xué xiào cān tīng chī wǔ fàn
ex.en: We eat lunch in the school dining hall.

texts.title: 读一读 · 饣 food (食字旁)

lines.zh: 今天是春节，我们一家人在家里包饺子。
lines.p: jīn tiān shì chūn jié wǒ men yī jiā rén zài jiā lǐ bāo jiǎo zi

lines.zh: 妈妈做馅儿，爸爸和我包。
lines.p: mā ma zuò xiànr bà ba hé wǒ bāo

lines.zh: 奶奶说：“饺子要包得好看！”
lines.p: nǎi nai shuō jiǎo zi yào bāo de hǎo kàn

lines.zh: 晚上我们吃了很多饺子，还吃了妈妈做的饼。
lines.p: wǎn shang wǒ men chī le hěn duō jiǎo zi hái chī le mā ma zuò de bǐng

lines.zh: 吃完饭，大家都说：“太饱了！”
lines.p: chī wán fàn dà jiā dōu shuō tài bǎo le

lines.zh: 我们一边喝饮料一边看电视，很开心。
lines.p: wǒ men yī biān hē yǐn liào yī biān kàn diàn shì hěn kāi xīn

qs.q: 晚上除了饺子他们还吃了什么？
